name: kongjuiya-science-game
description: 콩쥐야 줘때써 web game packaged for iOS and Android with Capacitor.

scripts.mobile:sync:ios: npm run mobile:prepare && cap sync ios
scripts.mobile:sync:android: npm run mobile:prepare && cap sync android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync:ios && cap open ios
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync:android && cap open android
scripts.mobile:run:ios: npm run mobile:sync:ios && cap run ios
scripts.mobile:run:android: npm run mobile:sync:android && cap run android
